name: Wonderland's War

rounds.endCondition: Game ends after the 3rd round War phase

categories.label: Victory point track score (incl. 50+ tokens)
categories.labelVi: Điểm trên track VP (kể cả thẻ 50+)
categories.hint: Region victory awards (full for 1st, half for 2nd) and other VP gained during play.

categories.label: Castles on board
categories.hint: castles = castles on board; pointsPerCastle = 3-6 from the bottom row of your Forge tracks.

categories.label: Quest cards
categories.hint: questsOne = cards with exactly one half (Feat or Objective) met = 3 VP each; questsBoth = both halves met = 9 VP each.

categories.label: Madness Shard tokens
categories.hint: -1 VP per Shard token you hold at the end.

notes: family: area-majority. Final score = VP track + 3-6 per castle + quests - shards; highest total wins. The rulebook states no tiebreaker. Two-player rules (p.21) and Automa/solo, Duel and expansions not modelled. Castle value rises via the Castle spaces on Forge tracks (max 6 VP).

sources.title: Reaping the Rewards: A Second Chance for Wonderland's War
